nodes.label: GARCH Regime Engine (PRIMARY)
nodes.rationale: Replaces K-means with conditional variance classification for superior volatility regime detection. PRIMARY method for regime detection in v4.

nodes.label: Autoencoder Anomaly Detection
nodes.rationale: Data-driven anomaly detection replacing fixed thresholds. Adapts to market conditions. PyTorch autoencoder trained on historical ILI component vectors.

nodes.label: Bayesian Weight Optimizer (PRIMARY)
nodes.rationale: Closed-loop weight optimization with 3 profiles (Profit Maximizer, Throughput Maximizer, Regime Adaptor). Validation pipeline and auto-deployment.

nodes.label: Idempotency Keys on Ingestion
nodes.rationale: Exactly-once delivery semantics during retries. Prevents duplicate tick data from skewing ILI.

nodes.label: Last Known Good (LKG) Cache
nodes.rationale: Prevents NaN/empty results when sources are unreachable. Serves stale data with X-Data-Age header.

nodes.label: Bulkhead Executor Isolation
nodes.rationale: Prevents cascading thread pool starvation. Three dedicated pools for ingestion, computation, and high-volume WS.

nodes.label: Participation Governance
nodes.rationale: Formalizes signal admissibility decomposition. Makes decision logic auditable with explicit suppression reason logging.

nodes.label: Liquidity Stress Testing
nodes.rationale: Simulates extreme liquidity withdrawal scenarios (Swiss franc model, Repo Spike 2019, COVID 2020).

nodes.label: CNN-LSTM Regime Detector (Alternative A)
nodes.rationale: Deep learning ensemble for spatial+temporal dependencies. Pluggable A/B testing candidate against GARCH.

nodes.label: QED Quartic Potential Model (Alternative B)
nodes.rationale: Metastable quartic potential modeling. Crash probability from capital flow proxies.

nodes.label: Natural Disaster Exogenous Shock
nodes.rationale: EXOGENOUS_SHOCK regime override from USGS/GDACS feeds. Proactive DISLOCATED flagging before 5-day correlation breakdown.

nodes.label: Firefly Algorithm (Alternative Optimizer)
nodes.rationale: Population-based metaheuristic optimizer. A/B testing candidate against Bayesian optimizer.

nodes.label: Ambiguity Aversion Bands
nodes.rationale: Uncertainty bands on ILI, worst-case optimization mode. UNCERTAIN status when band exceeds threshold.

nodes.label: Liquidity Comovement Monitor (PRIMARY)
nodes.rationale: PCA-based variance factor on 5-min standardized spreads. Leading indicator for systemic stress.

nodes.label: Phantom Liquidity Detection (PRIMARY)
nodes.rationale: PLI comparing canceled vs. executed volume. Discounts ILI for unreliable depth.

nodes.label: Trader Toxicity Monitor (PRIMARY)
nodes.rationale: Toxicity scores based on order-to-trade ratios and round-trip percentage. Differentiates harmful vs. beneficial algorithmic trading.

nodes.label: Behavioural Risk Index (BRI)
nodes.rationale: BRI from OFI, spread volatility, sentiment polarity. Herding filter and panic guard. 5th axis on systemic risk heatmap.

nodes.label: Market Stability Guardrails
nodes.rationale: MarketStabilityGuard + OrderImpactPredictor pre-trade checks. Prevents flash crash contribution. Big Red Button kill-switch with <50ms latency.

nodes.label: AUMF Five-Stage Framework
nodes.rationale: Scenario-based signal suppression, ethical boundary filters, SAFE_MODE/SUSPENDED_UNCERTAINTY/PROCEED_CAUTIOUSLY statuses.

nodes.label: Sobol Quasi-Random Monte Carlo
nodes.rationale: Better state-space coverage than pseudo-random for stress-testing ILI signals.

nodes.label: Broadie-Kou-Glasserman Discrete Monitoring Correction
nodes.rationale: Riemann Zeta-based beta correction for discrete barrier monitoring. beta = -zeta(1/2)/sqrt(2*pi) approx 0.5826.

nodes.label: Market Gamma / GEX Monitor
nodes.rationale: BSM Greeks calculation, gamma flip zone detection. Optional 6th axis on systemic risk heatmap. Pluggable.

nodes.label: Intraday Session Filter (Defining Range)
nodes.rationale: DR-based signal confidence, news confidence decay, 2:1 RRR testing for DR breaches. Time-adaptive thresholds based on reverse U-shape intraday pattern.

nodes.label: Return Gap Diagnostic
nodes.rationale: Separates execution alpha from static holdings return. Tracks interim trading profits separately.

nodes.label: Event-Based Intrinsic Time
nodes.rationale: Scale-invariant, event-driven aggregation. SurpriseIndicator for anomalous trajectories. Directional change and overshoot events.

nodes.label: Climate-Liquidity Sensitivity Factor
nodes.rationale: Long-term structural macro adjustment. Multi-country trade model simulation for energy shift dynamics. Climate sensitivity factor for ILI thresholds.

nodes.label: RAHF Framework (GARCH+NN)
nodes.rationale: GARCH + neural network hybrid for regime classification. Latent-regime view with MSFE tracking. Alternative B for weight optimization.

nodes.label: Efficiency-Depth Weighting
nodes.rationale: Regime-aware weights based on efficiency regimes. Spread and volatility weights boosted during low-efficiency periods.

nodes.label: Stochastic Drift-Diffusion Framework
nodes.rationale: Ito process framework for continuous parameter monitoring. Complements autoencoder point-in-time detection.

nodes.label: Price Jump Ratio Diagnostic
nodes.rationale: Quantifies signal informativeness relative to announcement-period price variation. PJR = CAR(T-a,T+b)/CAR(T-k,T+b).

nodes.label: Chaos Testing in CI
nodes.rationale: Validates resilience patterns under adverse conditions. Part of CI/CD pipeline.

nodes.label: Algorithmic Intensity KPI
nodes.rationale: Message-based AT proxy. Negative Dollar Volume / Number of Messages. Quintile bucketing for liquidity premium.

nodes.label: Trader-Type Liquidity Dynamics
nodes.rationale: Source classifier for ALGO/Institutional/Professional/Retail. Spread compression and cancellation monitoring.

nodes.label: De-Rounding Data Filter
nodes.rationale: Smooths AT activity spikes at round time marks. Reduces noise from human programmer bias.

nodes.label: Time-Periodicity Filter
nodes.rationale: Removes 1-second granular algorithmic loop artifacts. Complements de-rounding filter.

nodes.label: ML Reproducibility Scoring (RDS)
nodes.rationale: 0-2 rubric for disclosure quality. Audit-grade artifacts for regulator-defensible deployment. Three dimensions: code, data, reproducibility.
